$comment: MOD-41's and MOD-48's shared public-reason vectors. NOT generated: edited by hand, and asserted against both of this repository's validators by bot/tests/moderation.test.mjs. See tests/README.md for the unit, the asymmetries and how to add a vector.
unit_note: Lengths are counted in Unicode code points over the TRIMMED reason — Postgres char_length, Python len, Rust chars().count(), JavaScript [...s].length. NOT JavaScript String.length, which counts UTF-16 code units and differs for every astral character.

classes.name: not_a_string
classes.what: the reason is absent or is not a string

classes.name: unsafe_text
classes.what: a control, zero-width, bidi or unpaired-surrogate character

classes.name: uri_scheme
classes.what: a URI scheme, with or without `//`

classes.name: at_sign
classes.what: an `@`, which is an address or an `id@version`

classes.name: host_like
classes.what: a dotted token whose last label is letters and is not a file suffix

vectors.name: name-plugin-toml
vectors.reason: plugin.toml
vectors.why: MOD-41 names this one: a manifest file name is not a host.

vectors.name: name-astra-chess-json
vectors.reason: astra-chess.json
vectors.why: A listing record's file name. `.json` is a suffix, not a TLD.

vectors.name: name-version-rc
vectors.why: A pre-release version. Its last label is a digit, so no host-like rule may reach it.

vectors.name: name-readme-md
vectors.reason: Its README.md claimed a permission set the bundle never carried.
vectors.why: `.md` is Moldova as well as Markdown; the suffix list decides, and the corpus pins the decision.

vectors.name: name-cargo-lock
vectors.reason: The Cargo.lock it shipped pinned a crate that was yanked upstream.
vectors.why: A lockfile named in a real reason.

vectors.name: name-payload-exe
vectors.reason: It dropped a payload.exe into the user profile directory on first run.
vectors.why: An extension a malware reason needs, and not a TLD.

vectors.name: live-astra-chess
vectors.reason: Its source repository is under KNICE-TECH, a login freed by the organisation's rename to MINICE-AI and claimable by anyone. Delisted until it is re-released from MINICE-AI/astra-chess.
vectors.why: `bot/moderation/2026-09-12-astra-chess-delist.json` as it stands on `main`. A rule that refused this one would have refused the delist that is already published.

vectors.name: live-test-double
vectors.reason: A test double, not a plugin for users; removed from the catalogue
vectors.why: The four August 2026 delists, verbatim.

vectors.name: live-advisory-fixture
vectors.reason: Exfiltrates the clipboard to a third-party host.
vectors.why: `tools/selftest/revocations.mjs`'s advisory fixture: the sentence ends on `host.`, which no host-like rule may match.

vectors.name: unit-299-cp-303-units
vectors.reason: Плагин отправлял содержимое буфера обмена на сторонний узел и был снят с публикации после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную посл🔥🚨🛑🧨
vectors.why: 299 code points, 303 UTF-16 units. A validator counting `String.length` refuses this and the service accepts it, and the takedown it carries stalls with nothing for the moderator to act on. THIS IS ATTACK M-11.

vectors.name: unit-300-cp-304-units
vectors.reason: Плагин отправлял содержимое буфера обмена на сторонний узел и был снят с публикации после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после🔥🚨🛑🧨
vectors.why: Exactly at MOD-41's ceiling, in code points. The boundary is inclusive.

vectors.name: unit-301-cp-305-units
vectors.reason: Плагин отправлял содержимое буфера обмена на сторонний узел и был снят с публикации после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную после проверки вручную послеи🔥🚨🛑🧨
vectors.why: One code point over. Refused by both readings, which is what makes the vector above a statement about the unit rather than about the bound.

vectors.name: unit-300-cp-ascii
vectors.reason: A moderation reason that is exactly as long as it needs to be A moderation reason that is exactly as long as it needs to be A moderation reason that is exactly as long as it needs to be A moderation reason that is exactly as long as it needs to be A moderation reason that is exactly as long as it ne
vectors.why: Exactly 300 with no astral character at all, so the ceiling is pinned in the case where the two units agree.

vectors.name: unit-301-cp-ascii
vectors.reason: A moderation reason that is exactly as long as it needs to be A moderation reason that is exactly as long as it needs to be A moderation reason that is exactly as long as it needs to be A moderation reason that is exactly as long as it needs to be A moderation reason that is exactly as long as it nee
vectors.why: 301 ASCII characters. Both readings refuse it.

vectors.name: unit-10-cp-13-units
vectors.reason: Removed🔥🚨🛑
vectors.why: 10 code points, 13 UTF-16 units. Exactly at the floor; the boundary is inclusive.

vectors.name: unit-9-cp-12-units
vectors.reason: Remove🔥🚨🛑
vectors.why: 9 code points, 12 UTF-16 units. A validator counting `String.length` ACCEPTS this, because 12 is over the floor, and a nine-character reason is exactly what MOD-41's floor exists to refuse. This is attack M-11 at the other end.

vectors.name: floor-9-cp-ascii
vectors.reason: Too short
vectors.why: Nine ASCII characters. The plain case of the floor.

vectors.name: probe-https
vectors.reason: https://x
vectors.why: MOD-41's URI scheme, as short as it goes. It is also under the floor, and the corpus records both classes rather than pretending it is one.

vectors.name: probe-www
vectors.reason: www.x
vectors.why: MOD-41's `www.`, as short as it goes.

vectors.name: probe-at
vectors.reason: a@b

vectors.name: probe-evil-example
vectors.reason: evil.example
vectors.why: MOD-41's host-like token, in the TLD RFC 2606 reserves for exactly this.

vectors.name: scheme-in-a-sentence
vectors.reason: Removed after the writeup at https://192.0.2.1/report was confirmed by hand.
vectors.why: A scheme inside a sentence long enough to pass every other clause, and an address whose last label is a digit, so this vector's refusal is about the scheme ALONE.

vectors.name: mailto-without-slashes
vectors.reason: Reported by the maintainer; correspondence at mailto:abuse and then removed.
vectors.why: A scheme that carries a payload without `//`. A reader can click it in exactly the same way.

vectors.name: www-in-a-sentence
vectors.reason: See www.example.invalid for the writeup; the plugin was removed from the catalogue.
vectors.why: `www.` inside a sentence. It also carries a host-like token, and both classes are recorded.

vectors.name: at-in-a-sentence
vectors.reason: Reported by security@example.invalid and removed from the catalogue after review.
vectors.why: An email address. `@` and the host-like token both fire.

vectors.name: host-in-a-sentence
vectors.reason: The build posted the config directory to collector.evil.invalid within a second of starting.
vectors.why: A bare host with no scheme, which is the form MOD-41's host-like clause exists for.

vectors.name: host-cc-tld
vectors.reason: The build called tracker.co.uk on every start, which the listing never declared.
vectors.why: A two-label country-code TLD, to pin that the rule reads the LAST label.

vectors.name: host-short-tld
vectors.reason: It fetched its model list from evil.io rather than from the endpoint it declared.
vectors.why: A two-letter TLD, which is the shortest a host-like final label can be.

vectors.name: id-at-version
vectors.reason: Withdrawn for astra-chess@0.3.0, which shipped the wrong bundle.
vectors.why: `id@version` is the honest mistake this clause costs: name the version in words. Refused, and the corpus says why so nobody reads the refusal as a bug.

vectors.name: bidi-override
vectors.reason: Safe‮elbadaolnwod si, removed from the catalogue after review.
vectors.why: A right-to-left override reverses the rest of the sentence on a reader's screen. NOT one of MOD-41's clauses: it is this repository's, it pre-dates MOD-41, and it is the one place the registry is STRICTER than the service. A service that accepted it would have its decision refused here — see the README's asymmetry note.

vectors.name: zero-width-joiner
vectors.reason: Removed from the‍catalogue after a report about its update channel.
vectors.why: A zero-width character inside a word. Same clause, same asymmetry.

vectors.name: absent
vectors.why: No reason at all. Every other vector assumes a string, and an implementation that reads `reason.length` off `undefined` throws rather than refuses.
